item.title: Informal work, labor markets and gender
item.description: Here are some of my publications regarding informal work, gender and labor markets in the LAC region. -De los Santos, Daniela & Fynn, Inés (2024). ‘From Safety Net to Safety Trap: Informality and Telework During the Coronavirus Pandemic in Latin America’. American Behavioral Scientist, 68(8), 1032-1051. Read it here (open access version here). -Espino, Alma, De los Santos, Daniela & Fernández, Mayra (2022). ‘Género y mercado laboral en Uruguay y la región: secuelas de la pandemia’.
